output:
To: timeline:rosario.bautista
Replying to: none
Cc: none
Subject: none

SHE DID IT!!! 🎉🎉🎉 My bestfriend @Lorna Villaruz got her NMC PIN today!!! I am so happy I cannot even type properly, I am at clinic and my hands are shaking haha 😭❤️

Lorna and me go way back. Nursing school in Iloilo, capping ceremony 1996, same hairstyle, same dream 😂 In our dorm we polished our white shoes every night before duty, and every single night she borrowed my polish. Every night!! 4 years and she never bought her own lol. Lorna, I am still waiting for my polish back, with interest ha 😂

Then life took us different ways. She went to Riyadh, then Dubai, almost 18 years working so hard over there. I came to the UK in 2004. I will never forget at the airport, she was crying and crying and she said to me "Charing, susunod ako. I will follow you." 22 years later... SHE IS FOLLOWING ME HAHAHA 😂😂 20 years I have been telling her come to Liverpool, come to Liverpool, and finally she listened!! Proof that if you nag someone long enough it works. Ben can confirm 😂

She did her OSCE in Nottingham and I sent her a photo of the rain so she knows what she is getting into. She still came. That is real love 😂🌧️

So here is the plan!!! ✈️ Lorna lands in Manchester on 14 January from Dubai, and I will be there at arrivals with a big sign, maybe a banner, maybe a band, we will see 😂 Then she starts on 25 January on Ward 7 medical at Mersey Bank Hospital. Ward 7, you are so lucky, you don't know yet. Lorna is the best nurse I know. Calm in any situation, never panic, and the patients just love her. You will see, after one week they will be asking for her by name.

She is staying with us the first month in the spare room. Ben says ok (I didn't really give him a choice but he says ok 😂). Andrea, I am clearing your boxes anak, sorry not sorry. And Lorna, I heard you are bringing dried mangoes and pili for Tito Ben so you are already his favourite, I can see it 🥭

Lorna, important advice from your Ate here: BRING A PROPER COAT!!! Not the cute one, the warm one. Liverpool wind is no joke, it will blow you all the way back to Dubai 😂🧥 Don't worry, if your coat is not enough we go Primark or TK Maxx the first weekend. Also thick socks. Also a hat. Trust me.

And welcome to our Filipino family here in Merseyside!! 🇵🇭❤️ You are not alone here, we have a big big family waiting for you. The Christmas parties with the potluck (and always too much pancit haha), the karaoke, the chismis, everything. And next December you are coming with us to Simbang Gabi at St Teresa's, nine nights, no excuses, I will drag you if I have to 🙏

Lorna, I am so proud of you. All your hard work, all the papers, all the waiting, and you never gave up. Thank you Lord for this answered prayer. 30 years of friendship and now finally we are in the same city again. My sister from another mother, Liverpool is ready for you, and so am I 🥹❤️

See you on 14 January bestie!!! Start packing (and buy your own shoe polish this time) 😂❤️🎉
